author: smcarus
title: Will the US policy rate be lower on 30 June 2027 than when entries close?
summary: Give the probability that the BIS daily policy rate for the United States (the federal funds target) on 30 June 2027 is below its value on the day entries close.
knownLimits: BIS reports the midpoint of the target range for the United States.
BIS daily data can lag a decision by a few days.
